title.narrative: TWAS Research Grants and Science diplomacy programme 2012-2016
TWAS Research Grants and Science diplomacy programme 2012-2016

description.narrative: Målet är att stärka forskning inom matematik, fysik, kemi och biologi i fattiga länder, samt öka kunskapen hos nationella regeringar om fördelarna med att investera i vetenskap och teknik. TWAS Research Grants Program ger anslag till forskningsprojekt inom biologi, kemi, matematik och fysik av antingen enskilda forskare eller forskningsgrupper.

The goal is to strengthen research in mathematics, physics, chemistry and biology in poor countries, and to increase awareness among governments about the benefits of investing in science and technology. Twas Research Grants Program provides funding for research in biology, chemistry, mathematics and physics of either individual researchers or research groups.

To increase, within the next 5 years the production and use of high-quality research of relevance to target countries, conducted by individual scientists, groups and consortia. Establishment within 2 years an international programme in science diplomacy within TWAS (in partnership with the US based AAAS).Establishment within 5 years, activities that will enhance links between scientists and government representatives.

During the Jan 2012 – Apr 2017, TWAS Programmes supported by Sida continued to grow delivering effective actions of capacity building and innovation.
